study.title: Accelerating UAV-Based Agricultural Field Segmentation Using YOLOv11 and Rockchip NPU Quantization
study.short_title: Crop/weed/soil: YOLOv11s-seg mAP@0.5 0.85, INT8 16 ms on RK3588 NPU
study.venue: 2026 Systems of Signal Synchronization, Generating and Processing in Telecommunications (SYNCHROINFO)

segmentation.domain: Edge-AI acceleration of crop/weed/soil segmentation from UAV video: YOLOv11n-seg and YOLOv11s-seg trained on combined real + synthetic UAV imagery, post-training INT8-quantized to RKNN, and deployed on a Rockchip RK3588 NPU (Orange Pi 5+) for real-time onboard agricultural analytics
segmentation.best_model: YOLOv11s-seg in RKNN INT8: mAP@0.5 0.85, Precision 0.85, Recall 0.79, 16 ms on RK3588 NPU (best accuracy); YOLOv11n-seg.rknn fastest at 12 ms (mAP@0.5 0.82, P 0.82, R 0.76)

dataset.name: Combined custom dataset: real UAV imagery plus synthetic samples for crop, weed, and soil segmentation (512x512 inputs); class distribution Crop 68/Weed 22/Soil 10 (train) and 70/20/10 (test)
dataset.note: Synthetic images added for pixel-accurate annotations and diversity; training set/test set class proportions preserved. No image counts, location, or flight parameters disclosed. Augmentation: random horizontal flip, rotation, brightness, contrast.

segmentation.backbone: Ultralytics YOLOv11seg (nano and small variants), 200 epochs, batch 16, 512x512; ONNX export -> RKNN Toolkit2, post-training INT8 quantization (100 calibration images)

mIoU.ambiguity: Instance-segmentation study; primary metric is mAP@0.5 (per-instance), no mIoU reported.

F1.ambiguity: Instance-level Precision and Recall reported (YOLOv11s-seg.rknn P 0.85 / R 0.79) but no F1; deriving F1 would conflate instance-level statistics with semantic metrics.

weed_F1.ambiguity: No per-class segmentation F1; only instance-level P/R/mAP.

edge.device: Orange Pi 5+ single-board computer (Rockchip RK3588 SoC) with integrated NPU (up to 6 TOPS INT8)
edge.framework: RKNN Toolkit2 (post-training INT8 quantization, 100 calibration images; ONNX from Ultralytics PyTorch YOLOv11seg)

fps.quote: YOLOv11s-seg.rknn ... 16 (ms); the RKNN models executed on the Rockchip NPU achieve a latency reduction of approximately 2.6x for YOLOv11n-seg and 2.7x for YOLOv11s-seg compared to the original PyTorch implementations
fps.section: V. Results and Discussion / Table II
fps.ambiguity: FPS not directly reported; derived as 1000/16 from the reported YOLOv11s-seg.rknn latency (best-accuracy edge model). YOLOv11n-seg.rknn runs at 12 ms (~83.3 fps). NPU measured latency: 12 vs 31 ms (nano), 16 vs 43 ms (small) for RKNN vs PyTorch .pt.

latency_ms.section: V. Results and Discussion / Table II
latency_ms.ambiguity: Measured latency for the best-accuracy deployed model (YOLOv11s-seg.rknn on RK3588 NPU). Fastest variant YOLOv11n-seg.rknn = 12 ms (2.6x vs 31 ms PyTorch); INT8 speedup 2.6-2.7x overall. Latencies measured with RKNN runtime tools on the SBC itself - genuine edge measurement.

power_w.ambiguity: Low-power claims qualitative only; no wattage measured.

params_M.ambiguity: Parameter counts not stated in the paper.

issues: edge.reported=true: genuine on-device deployment on Rockchip RK3588 NPU (Orange Pi 5+), INT8 post-training quantization; real measured latencies (16 ms best-accuracy, 12 ms fastest) and 2.6-2.7x speedup vs PyTorch; ~2-3 point mAP@0.5 loss from INT8.
Instance segmentation: primary metric mAP@0.5 (0.85 YOLOv11s-seg.rknn; 0.88 FP32 PyTorch); precision/recall instance-level - no pixel-level semantic metrics (mIoU/mPA/F1/Dice/PA all false).
Dataset is real UAV + synthetic mix with no image counts, location, or flight altitude/GSD disclosed; classes crop/weed/soil, 512x512 inputs.
Power consumption not measured despite low-power claims; params/FLOPs not stated.
